chapters.name: Aurmachd knàim
chapters.text: Arms and armour of Age I. Hide cut and stitched over bone plates, the dress of the first hunters and the Telling singers' guards.

items.name: Umlaig knàim
items.text: Bow of Age I: arrows hit x0.9 of a plain bow's damage, 300 uses. Crafted from bone plates x3 and string x3.

items.name: Skiad knàim
items.text: Off-hand shield of Age I: blocks 80% of a blow from the front, 160 uses. Crafted from bone plates x3 and planks x4.

chapters.name: Aurmachd uma
chapters.text: Arms and armour of Age II. Beaten copper over hide, the first metal of the herders and the cairn builders.

items.name: Umlaig uma
items.text: Bow of Age II: arrows hit x0.95 of a plain bow's damage, 330 uses. Crafted from copper ingots x3 and string x3.

items.name: Skiad uma
items.text: Off-hand shield of Age II: blocks 85% of a blow from the front, 260 uses. Crafted from copper ingots x3 and planks x4.

chapters.name: Aurmachd krèuma
chapters.text: Arms and armour of Age III. Bronze with red and blue enamel studs in the curving style of the island smiths.

items.name: Umlaig krèuma
items.text: Bow of Age III: arrows hit x1 of a plain bow's damage, 384 uses. Crafted from bronze ingots x3 and string x3.

items.name: Skiad krèuma
items.text: Off-hand shield of Age III: blocks 90% of a blow from the front, 330 uses. Crafted from bronze ingots x3 and planks x4.

chapters.name: Aurmachd iarund
chapters.text: Arms and armour of Age IV. Rings of iron linked by hand, the road-warden's coat in the age of kings.

items.name: Umlaig iarund
items.text: Bow of Age IV: arrows hit x1.05 of a plain bow's damage, 420 uses. Crafted from iron ingots x3 and string x3.

items.name: Umlaig kroisi iarund
items.text: Crossbow of Age IV: bolts hit x1.15 of a plain bow's damage, 465 uses. Crafted from rods x3, iron ingots x1, string x2 and a tripwire hook.

items.name: Skiad iarund
items.text: Off-hand shield of Age IV: blocks 95% of a blow from the front, 420 uses. Crafted from iron ingots x3 and planks x4.

chapters.name: Aurmachd kruoid
chapters.text: Arms and armour of Age V. Plate and blade of true steel, the first gear of the mills, the rails and the early cities. Sword, axe and spear start here.

items.name: Klaidem kruoid
items.text: Steady sword: 7 attack damage, 1.6 swings a second, sweeps nearby foes, 900 uses. Crafted from steel ingots x2 and a rod; Age V.

items.name: Tuog kruoid
items.text: Heavy axe: 10 attack damage, 0.9 swings a second, chops wood and can knock a raised shield down. 900 uses. Crafted from steel ingots x3 and rods x2; Age V.

items.name: Slieg kruoid
items.text: Long spear for lunging while moving: 4 base damage, charge damage x1. 900 uses. Crafted from steel ingots x1 and rods x2; Age V.

items.name: Umlaig kruoid
items.text: Bow of Age V: arrows hit x1.15 of a plain bow's damage, 560 uses. Crafted from steel ingots x3 and string x3.

items.name: Umlaig kroisi kruoid
items.text: Crossbow of Age V: bolts hit x1.3 of a plain bow's damage, 600 uses. Crafted from rods x3, steel ingots x1, string x2 and a tripwire hook.

items.name: Skiad kruoid
items.text: Off-hand shield of Age V: blocks 100% of a blow from the front, 600 uses. Crafted from steel ingots x3 and planks x4.
